Name: Giant Meadowlands Farm
Author: Kanalotvar
Description: A huge farm map with plenty of space for farming, construction, and livestock raising. The farm features a pond for your watering can, as well as paths that divide the farm into natural zones. The farm is based on and replaces the standard farm, so it will conflict with other farms that replace the standard farm. This mod should be compatible with most recolor mods, but I can't be sure since I'm playing with the vanilla color scheme. This is my first mod, so if you find any errors or bugs, please let me know, and I'll try to fix them. The map size is 199x180 tiles, for a total of 35,8k tiles. Without the background and cliffs, I think there are around 30k tiles suitable for farming and building.
